belief_update: I still think I should be able to handle my classroom without breaking down, but I also know that's not always how it goes. I wonder if people would judge me if they knew, but I don't know for sure. I keep most of it hidden, even from the people who care about me, because it feels safer that way. Some days I believe my anxiety doesn't make me any less of a teacher or a father, other days I'm not so sure. I don't talk about it much, even when it's hard, because I don't know how to say it without it feeling like a failure. I don't know if I'm worth less because of it, but I don't know if I'm worth more either. I let a little of it show sometimes, but not enough for anyone to really see what's going on.
